Alpha Vantage API Documentation

Technical Indicators

Calculate various technical indicators using historical price data.

SMA

This API returns the simple moving average (SMA) values.

Parameters

Name Type Description Default Options
function string The API function to call - -
symbol string The stock symbol to query - -
interval string Time interval between data points daily 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly, monthly
time_period integer Number of data points used to calculate each moving average value 20 -
series_type string The desired price type in the time series close • close
• open
• high
• low
datatype string Data format to return json json, csv, xml
apikey string Your API key - -

RSI

This API returns the relative strength index (RSI) values.

Parameters

Name Type Description
function string The API function to call
symbol string The stock symbol to query
interval string Time interval between data points
time_period integer Number of data points used to calculate each RSI value
series_type string The desired price type in the time series
